## book_appointment (Retell tool)
First checks x-retell-signature (key: n8n Variable RETELL_API_KEY); unsigned requests get 401 unauthorized. Then rejects in this order: missing_field:<name>, brand_not_covered_for_warranty (warranty only for LG / Samsung / GE), fee_not_accepted (paid jobs need the $99 fee agreed), slot_unavailable (not a future Mon–Fri 2-hour window, or already booked). Otherwise inserts the row and returns booked.
